scientific_integrity.claim_basis: Analytic degenerate-eigenspace splitting and finite-dimensional resolvent identities; numerical verification is corroboration only.
limitations: Finite homogeneous nearest-neighbor cycles, one irreversible local detector, fixed positive loss rate, weak total flux approaching zero.
No claim for stroboscopic first measurements, multiple detectors, disordered hoppings, or joint system-size and weak-flux limits.
Earlier non-Hermitian trapping, dark-state detection, and general return-time formulas are credited; an equivalent specialized earlier flux formula cannot be categorically excluded.

title: Magnetic-flux lifting of dark states: exact singular absorption times on quantum cycles
